name: button-group
need: Join related actions or toggles into one pill outline

--ds-btn-group-radius.description: button group: the outer corners (at most half the height, times `--ds-shape`); the inner corners are square

--ds-btn-group-divider.default: the buttons' border; filled or tonal: the label colour at `--ds-state-disabled` (38%) in the fill
--ds-btn-group-divider.description: button group: the line between two buttons
